question: Within a radius of 50 kilometers, where can I locate café on the journey from IIT Stuart School of Business, Chicago, IL to the Guesthouse Hotel, Chicago, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%IIT Stuart School of Business%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1), (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%The Guesthouse Hotel%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Chicago%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1) )::geography, 50000 -- 50 kilometers in meters )::geography );
